May 13, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Solaris Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Wells Fargo & Company (WFC) by 8.69% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Solaris Asset Management Llc bought 5,615 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.98% with the market. The institutional investor held 70,227 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.26 million, up from 64,612 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Solaris Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Wells Fargo & Company for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $265.33B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.37% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $54.45. About 14.42M shares traded. Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) has declined 7.75% since May 13, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.30% the S&P500.
Intrust Bank Na decreased its stake in China Mobile Limited (CHL) by 73.39% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Intrust Bank Na sold 16,698 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.06% with the market. The institutional investor held 6,054 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $306,000, down from 22,752 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Intrust Bank Na who had been investing in China Mobile Limited for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $189.83 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.02% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $46.93. About 817,993 shares traded. China Mobile Limited (NYSE:CHL) has declined 14.69% since May 13, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 26.24% the S&P500.
